selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler begin to study in this part?
questions.answer: He began to study upright minds and bright hearts.

questions.question: Were their opinions alike because they were all the same kind of people?
questions.answer: No. They had different abilities, ways, and views.

questions.question: How strong was their certainty?
questions.answer: It was steady and strong.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the strength of that truth in them?
questions.answer: It is deep-rooted and cannot be uprooted.

questions.question: What did that shining chain open like?
questions.answer: A bright window to the truth.

questions.question: What else agreed besides their beliefs?
questions.answer: Their unveilings and witnessings also agreed.

questions.question: What did each bright heart show like a small seat of knowledge?
questions.answer: Knowledge of the Lord.

questions.question: Why are all the hearts together compared to an ocean reflecting sunlight?
questions.answer: Because many hearts together show truth in a great and beautiful way.

questions.question: Why does their agreement make a trustworthy guide?
questions.answer: Because so many clear hearts and minds would not all be tricked by something false.

questions.question: How did the traveler answer this lesson with both mind and heart?
questions.answer: He declared his faith in Allah.

questions.question: Who are the two groups the traveler learns from in this passage?
questions.answer: Upright intellects and luminous hearts.

questions.question: What was united in them?
questions.answer: Their belief in Allah’s unity.

questions.question: In spite of those differences, what belief did they all share?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah is one.

questions.question: What kind of certainty did they have?
questions.answer: Strong and settled certainty.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the roots of that truth?
questions.answer: They were deep and could not be pulled out.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice about the witness of the sound intellects?
questions.answer: It matched and fit together.

questions.question: How are the luminous hearts described in relation to truth?
questions.answer: They were connected to it and showed it.

questions.question: What do many hearts together become?
questions.answer: A very large mirror, like a shining sea.

questions.question: What are all the hearts together compared to?
questions.answer: A great mirror, like a sea reflecting sunlight.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the claim that all of them were deceived?
questions.answer: It is too corrupt and unreasonable to accept.

questions.question: At the start of the passage, what did the traveler notice about enlightened minds?
questions.answer: He noticed that they shared the same belief about Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Did those intellects all have the same strength and style?
questions.answer: No. They differed in ability and way.

questions.question: What stayed the same even when their methods differed?
questions.answer: Their strong belief and certainty.

questions.question: What picture is used for their agreement in faith?
questions.answer: A strong, shining chain.
